integrity: The infinite family is proved symbolically. The finite-field replay is supplementary and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires prime p at least 5 and odd extension degree m at least 3.
No claim is made for even extension degree, p=3, or nonprime base fields.
title: Exact minimum-weight span of odd-extension \(p\)-ary BCH codes of designed distance three
